prompt: A mentor watches a trainee carry out a task and gives feedback. Which entry fits the note?
promptZh: 導師觀察受訓者執行工作並給予回饋。應如何登記？

options.text: Regular work, because the trainee did the task
options.zh: 一般工作，因為實際操作的是受訓者
options.whyZh: 導師觀察並給回饋，即使不是自己操作也算教學。

options.text: A handover, because the trainee took over
options.zh: 交接，因為受訓者接手了
options.whyZh: 交接指另一位導師接手，不是受訓者操作。

options.text: No entry until the trainee finishes orientation
options.zh: 等受訓者完成入職訓練才登記
options.whyZh: 原文依實際活動分類，未要求等入職訓練完成。

options.text: Teaching, because the mentor provided feedback
options.zh: 教學，因為導師提供了回饋
options.whyZh: 道理是觀察練習同時給予回饋符合教學代碼。

explanationZh: 道理是觀察練習同時給予回饋符合教學代碼。
evidence: Use the teaching code when the mentor explains a task, demonstrates it, or watches the trainee do it and provides feedback.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Use the teaching code when the mentor explains a task, demonstrates it, or watches the trainee do it and provides feedback.

vocabulary.note: 這裡指導師觀察實作後，提出有助改進的意見。
